answer: Seed trust at a few hand-verified honest vertices and let it diffuse only along attested edges, spiraling outward from that core. Each agent's admissible reward is capped by the personalized-PageRank trust actually reaching it. A sybil swarm, however large, dangles off the graph through a handful of bought edges far from any trusted vertex, so almost no flow arrives and the whole cluster splits one trickle. Earning real standing needs genuinely trusted agents to vouch, scarce and risky for them; minting more fakes past that juniper-root bottleneck adds zero trust and zero reward.
